studies.title: A gridded map in stone
studies.caption: The Map of the Tracks of Yu is carved on a stele on a grid of squares a hundred li across, with rivers and coasts strikingly accurate.
studies.prompt: Oblique close view in twelfth-century Xian of a dark rectangular stone stele incised with a fine square grid, dense river network and Chinese coastline; one artisan taking an ink rubbing with a sheet and pad. Marks suggested without readable labels; no modern political borders.
